scenario.title: Battle of Agorelitsa
intro.text:
BATTLE OF AGORELITSA - 17 JUL 1944

South of Korifasi, Peloponnese

You will carry out a strike against the German occupation forces on the western Peloponnese. Target of your attack is the 41st Fortress Division and the neutralization of the coastal artillery near Marathopoli. The Germans have some battle-hardened units in this area, so be careful!

GOAL Capture all VH!

NOTE The unit occupying the town Agorelitsa, gets the chance of a Leader!
player.speaker: Commander
line.reaction-22-0-briliant.speaker: Aris Velouchiotis
line.reaction-22-0-briliant.text: Kalabaka and the surrounding posts fell before EDES could concentrate. ELAS controls the area, and the occupation has gained another Greek quarrel to exploit.
line.reaction-22-1-victory-tactical.text: The objectives are under ELAS control, though armed groups escaped the cordon. The military result is clear; its place inside the resistance is not.
line.callback-0.speaker: Aris Velouchiotis
line.callback-0.text: The Kalabaka passes are ours. So are the grudges carried off by men who surrendered their rifles. I still prefer an enemy without a rifle.
line.callback-1.speaker: Stefanos Sarafis
line.callback-1.text: Some EDES men used the Kalabaka terms to go home. Others preserved their network for the next quarrel. You knew that risk and signed anyway; I have not forgotten either part.
line.callback-2.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.callback-2.text: The escape riders remained together and learned Greece one courier path at a time.
line.callback-3.speaker: Eleni Markou
line.callback-3.text: The mounted group was broken up, but its couriers tied distant ELAS units together more effectively than one cavalry troop could have.
line.scene-0.speaker: Aris Velouchiotis
line.scene-0.text: Those coastal guns have shelled villages and shipping for years. Take them intact and one partisan division owns more artillery than three mountain headquarters can promise.
line.scene-1.speaker: Stefanos Sarafis
line.scene-1.text: The guns are fixed. The German column is not. Close Kanalos and Lefki first, and the batteries can fire only while we empty the villages under them.
line.scene-2.speaker: Eleni Markou
line.scene-2.text: Evacuation has begun, but one settlement refuses to move until it sees our roadblocks. They have heard too many promises delivered after the shooting.
line.decision.speaker: Aris Velouchiotis
line.decision.text: Which do you want first, Commander—the guns before their crews destroy them, or the roads before the column escapes?
Strike the coastal batteries and communications before the column reacts.
Give artillery and reconnaissance 15 experience and fully rearm the core.
line.decision.choice.close-the-roads.tex: Seal Kanalos and Lefki, evacuate the villages, then destroy the trapped column.
line.decision.choice.close-the-roads.hin: Spend 50 prestige, give infantry 15 experience, and restore the core to at least nine strength with full fuel and ammunition.
line.choice-a-0.speaker: Stefanos Sarafis
line.choice-a-0.text: Then accept that the road force may get out. Assault parties carry demolition tools; a gun we cannot turn must not be left for the next village.
line.choice-a-1.speaker: Aris Velouchiotis
line.choice-a-1.text: They move tonight, before the roadblocks advertise us. I want the breechblocks, not photographs beside captured barrels.
line.choice-b-0.speaker: Aris Velouchiotis
line.choice-b-0.text: By the time the villages are empty, the gun crews may have orders to blow everything. That is the price you are choosing.
line.choice-b-1.speaker: Stefanos Sarafis
line.choice-b-1.text: Kanalos and Lefki close after the civilians pass. Then the column has roads on the map and none under its wheels.
